latin: Secundum omnes philosophos dicendum est deum necessario agere quicquid agit.
translation: According to all the philosophers it must be said that God necessarily does whatever he does.
translation_note: Farmer's note reads the phrase 'according to all philosophers' as signaling an implicit double-truth, resolved elsewhere by Pico's hierarchical modes of necessity (compare 2>14-15; farmer1998:20075); pico_stance is accordingly given as unstated rather than endorses.
